quote: WEG announces an investment plan of approximately R$ 543 million to increase transformer production capacity in Brazil. The investments will be made over the next two years in manufacturing units located in Minas Gerais and Rio Grande do Sul.
note: Opened WEG English; R$543m / Betim+Gravataí confirmed. CapEx-fill USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 5.1921 BRL/USD.
